title: Random-effects meta-analysis and forest plot
purpose: Pools study-level effects using inverse-variance fixed and DerSimonian-Laird random-effects methods, quantifies heterogeneity, and creates forest and funnel plots.
input: `Studies` sheet with study_id, author_year, effect_estimate, standard_error, outcome, and subgroup.
outputs: Pooled fixed and random effects, confidence intervals, Q, I-squared, tau-squared, study weights, forest plot, funnel plot, and subgroup summaries.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
